name: Truth or Dare
short: R-rated 18+ Discord Truth or Dare game with optional turn-taking.
description: 233 original, adult-flirty, chat-friendly truth and dare prompts with 25-prompt recent-history protection per channel/category. Shortcuts: [p]truth and [p]dare; [p]tod for random, join, leave, players, next, rules, and [p]todset on/off for administrators. Targeting other members requires explicit opt-in. No NSFW channel setting is required; participation is voluntary, and prompts exclude dangerous or explicit-image dares.
author: Will
end_user_data_statement: This cog retains participating Discord user IDs and the last-picked user ID only in running memory per channel, for opt-in target selection. No participant data or responses are saved persistently. Prompt history is kept as ephemeral numeric prompt indices. Only the server-level enabled/disabled setting is persisted. Players can leave any time, and Red's data-deletion hook removes affected user IDs from memory.
install_msg: Truth or Dare installed. Run [p]load truthordare and use [p]tod, [p]truth, or [p]dare in a server-approved channel. Players may opt in to being targeted with [p]tod join. Admins: [p]todset on/off.
